title: Kanmani Anbodu Kathalan
overview: Kanmani Anbodu Kathalan is an 2020 Malaysian TV movie that the story revolves around Kathalan, an oversized and lovable guy who always keep his surroundings joyful. Meanwhile, Kanmani is also someone who's avoiding marriage due to some mysterious reason. Their first meet somehow led to a second meet-up, that's when things revealed about Kanmani.
